timing_method: Exact current model core and training/evaluation functions on deterministic synthetic uint16 token streams solely for wall-clock timing; no scientific architecture verdict is drawn from timing NLLs.

projection.method: Linear projection from measured B_full and E_EH1 update/pass timings. B_narrow and B_ambient are conservatively budgeted at B_full timing. E_EH1 shuffle-bank construction overhead, environment setup, corpus regeneration, scheduler latency, and hardware variance are not included in the baseline projection.
projection.operational_budget_note: Expect modest additional billed time above baseline for eight cross-sequence and eight within-sequence shuffle-bank constructions in each E_EH1 run, per-job environment setup, deterministic corpus regeneration, and scheduler/runtime variance.

interpretation: Measured throughput places the complete four-arm by three-seed Architecture Smoke campaign in a tens-of-dollars, not hundreds-of-dollars, baseline A100 compute range.
forbidden_interpretation: Timing NLLs are synthetic-input timing data and are not admissible for WIDTH_PENALTY, AMBIENT_DENOMINATOR, HEAD_USE, TOKEN_CONDITIONING, HEAD_INCREMENT, or RECOVERY adjudication.
